notes.title: Small Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Just released an update fixing a couple of notes that weren't displaying properly, as well as a glitch in the driving level. Performance should be a little better now as well. Thanks for playing!

HAPPY ALMOST NEW YEAR! 
2021 is gonna be wild! Hang in there ya'll!

notes.title: Small Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Just a small update here, addressing a few issues.

Fixed two buggy cut-scenes near the end of the game as well as slightly improved performance.

Thanks! Stay Safe!

notes.title: A Dump in the Dark 1st Patch Live
notes.notes: Hey everyone, we just got a patch up to address some issues and optimizations to make the game play smoother and creamier. We're working on the first major update complete with a new chapter right now and its shaping up quite nicely. Keep an eye out for it in the coming week. Thanks all!
